C1354.title: BEC Token Integer Overflow Attack Incident
C1354.summary: On April 22, 2018, hackers exploited an integer overflow vulnerability in the BEC smart contract, passing extremely large values to produce abnormal calculation results, generating massive BEC tokens out of thin air and dumping them on the market, causing the token value to fall almost to zero. Code-level details such as the batchTransfer function, amount becoming zero, and bypassing balance checks should be supported by a contract code analysis source if retained.
